title: Dense Technical Notebook — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Notebook figure: shell, peel, trace
scenes.purpose: Show an idea (bulb silhouette) opening into a connected system: lock the exterior contour, peel one labelled contour layer back and trace an internal 5-node path.
visuals: Stationary graph-paper notebook page with red margin rule
LAYER B: dashed 1.6px inner contour panel hinged at x=962
Low-contrast 1px inactive circuit details inside the core
0.8px leaders and dimension lines with mono legends
Serif title block with mono notes

beats.development: Overall drawing reveals: shell contour draws, base lines, dimension h = 340 and fig. 3a leader; title block and LAYER B panel appear.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system.

beats.development: LAYER B folds open about its hinge (orthographic scaleX fold, front face swaps to hatched back at 1.15s) and rests 32° short of flat; the shell and drawing orientation stay locked; leader and legend attach.
Active red path traces through the revealed core; each node pops as the stroke arrives; the trace leader and legend attach.
Settled reading hold of the complete figure and all legends.

findings: Reveal, peel and trace occupy distinct, back-to-back windows with no dead time.
All copy is static and fully legible by 2.52s.
justifiedHolds: 2.52–3.00s settled hold so the final figure and legends can be read.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
Recipe demonstrated: the primary Motion Graphic's characteristic action (no optional preview_recipes are listed in STYLE.json).
SVG renderer, single paused GSAP timeline at window.__timelines.video; no Blender used.
